classification.difficultyReason: Choose between base–height and diagonal formulas, recognise external perpendicular heights in rotated rhombuses, and ignore an irrelevant side length. All required lengths are supplied directly.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these parallelograms, kites, and rhombuses. Round to 2 d.p. if needed.

spec.description: Right-slanting parallelogram with a 4 cm base, dashed 3 cm perpendicular height and matching parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: A=bh; the dashed vertical segment is the perpendicular height.
spec.answerVisibility: All measurements and marks are permanent givens; no answer is drawn.

spec.description: Upright kite with double ticks on the shorter upper sides, single ticks on the lower sides, a dashed 2 m horizontal diagonal and an external 4 m full vertical diagonal measurement.
spec.mathematics: The complete diagonals are 2 m and 4 m.

spec.description: Right-slanting rhombus, equal-side ticks, a dashed upper-left to lower-right diagonal labelled 25 mm, and an external oblique dimension labelled 40 mm parallel to the other complete diagonal.
spec.mathematics: 40 mm and 25 mm measure diagonals, not sides.

spec.description: Upright kite with longer upper sides singly ticked, shorter lower sides doubly ticked, dashed perpendicular diagonals and complete diagonal dimensions of 19 mm and 10 mm.
spec.mathematics: A=xy/2 with complete diagonals 19 mm and 10 mm.

spec.description: Left-slanting parallelogram with horizontal 2.8 m base, dashed 2.5 m vertical height, right-angle square and matching single/double parallel arrows.
Oblique rhombus with equal-side ticks, lower side labelled 6.1 cm and dashed 4.1 cm interior height from the lower-right vertex to the opposite side.
spec.mathematics: The dashed segment is perpendicular to the base-parallel opposite side; use A=bh.

answer.worked:
Use the rhombus as a parallelogram: 4.1 cm is the perpendicular height.

$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\A&=6.1\times4.1\\A&=25.01\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Long parallelogram descending to the right, 16 cm long base, matching parallel arrows and an external dashed 6 cm perpendicular height meeting a dashed base extension.
spec.mathematics: The external height is perpendicular to the 16 cm base.

spec.description: Very narrow rhombus ascending to the right, equal-side ticks, lower-right side labelled 3.6 m, dashed extension beyond that side and a 1.1 m external perpendicular height from the top vertex.
spec.mathematics: Use the 3.6 m side as the base and the external perpendicular distance 1.1 m as its height.

answer.worked:
Use the rhombus as a parallelogram with its external perpendicular height.

$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\A&=3.6\times1.1\\A&=3.96\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Sideways kite with shorter left sides singly ticked, longer right sides doubly ticked, a 38.2 cm complete horizontal diagonal dimension, a dashed 31.5 cm vertical diagonal and the supplied 27.5 cm lower-right side length.
spec.mathematics: The area uses the two complete diagonals; the supplied side length remains visible but is unused.
spec.answerVisibility: All three measurements are permanent givens; no answer is drawn.

answer.worked:
Use the diagonals, 38.2 cm and 31.5 cm.

$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{xy}{2}\\A&=\frac{38.2\times31.5}{2}\\A&=601.65\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
